releases.notes:
## Gold Sun Regen 1.0.0

Initial release for Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge 21.1.233+).

### Features
- Golden armor and held tools repair in direct sunlight
- Repair rate scales with sun position (midday fastest, dawn/dusk slower)
- Dropped golden items can repair on the ground
- Optional sunlight particles and resonance effects
- Fully configurable in-game

### Installation
1. Install NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1
2. Place the JAR in your `mods` folder
